summary: Campus through road kerb with no cars parked and a bus zone.
reasons: Through road, no parking this side
Bus zone sign at the kerb

drivers.seclusion: University buildings 41 m or more away, no homes, but a bare kerb in plain view of the road.
drivers.access_and_room: South kerb is clear of cars and sits against a lawn strip and building; no marked parking lane on this side.
drivers.traffic: Collector road through campus with buses; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north kerb only; none on this south kerb.

flags: Bus Zone sign on this kerb
sun_shade: Mostly open; a tree shades the east end in the afternoon.
